primegodling.race.half_godling.descripti: A fledgling being touched by divine essence — not yet a god, but no longer mere mortal. The Half Godling stands at the threshold between worlds, carrying a spark of primordial light that yearns to grow.
primegodling.race.demi_godling.descripti: The spark within begins to kindle. The Demi Godling sheds mortal frailty and steps further from the mundane, drawing power from the edges of the divine. The heavens take notice.
primegodling.race.prime_godling.descript: A newborn deity awakens — a being born from the weave of primordial light and will unshaped by fate. The Prime Godling gazes upon a world of limitless possibility, its soul carrying the echo of creation itself.
primegodling.race.celestial_godling.desc: The godling's mortal shell has been cast aside. What remains is pure celestial essence — a being woven from star-stuff and the first breath of the cosmos. The heavens themselves grow silent in recognition.
primegodling.race.ecliptic_godling.descr: Twilight bends to the Ecliptic Godling's will. Neither light nor dark may claim dominion where one who walks the ecliptic stands. The boundary between day and night becomes a threshold, not a barrier.
primegodling.race.new_god.description: Radiance given form. The New God burns with an inner sun that illuminates the unseen truths of existence. At this height, the veil between the mortal and the divine grows thin enough to step through.
primegodling.race.primordial_supreme_god: The journey ends where it began — at the source of all things. The Primordial Supreme God is no longer a being who wields power; it has become the hand that writes what power is. Existence bends, and does not break.
primegodling.skill.primordial_bloom.desc: Passively regenerates magicules. Periodically spawns blooming particles. Mastery: also grants Regeneration to nearby players.
primegodling.skill.cosmic_awareness.desc: Toggle: grants presence sense, detects invisible entities, and marks entities that target the bearer. Drains energy while active.
primegodling.skill.stellar_ascension.des: Toggle: boosts attack damage and maximum health with a celestial particle aura. Deals bonus magic damage on attack. Mastery: slow falling while falling.
primegodling.skill.ecliptic_mastery.desc: Passively grants bonus armor and toughness. Reflects damage back to attackers and has a chance to negate incoming damage. Mastery doubles the effect.
primegodling.skill.luminarch_blessing.de: Toggle: grants Regeneration, Absorption, and highlights all living entities within 24 blocks through walls (Glowing). Mastery: 48-block range and heals nearby allies.
Bestows overwhelming divine fortitude, boosting all core attributes. Grants Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, fall damage immunity, and 90-95% damage reduction. Greatly accelerates skill learning.
primegodling.skill.creation_authority.de: Ultimate Skill. Passively grants +6 Attack, +16 HP, +4 Armor, +4 Toughness. Press to call down primordial lightning that devastates the target area with a massive explosion. Grants brief damage immunity after activation. High energy cost.
primegodling.skill.divine_devour.descrip: Unique Skill. Press the skill key while looking at a mob to attempt to steal one of its skills. 10% chance per use. Cooldown: 10 seconds (5 when mastered).
awakening.primegodling.divine_nexus.name: Divine Nexus
awakening.primegodling.divine_nexus.desc: The third path alongside True Demon Lord and True Hero. Requires New God, 1M EP, and 1,000 Nexus Cores.
item.primegodling.nexus_core.desc: A crystallised fragment of raw creation energy. Use to unlock the Divine Nexus awakening.
item.primegodling.nexus_core.tooltip: New God only. Consume 1,000 to open the Divine Nexus path.

advancements.primegodling.new_god.descri: Evolve to New God — the gatekeeper of the Divine Nexus
advancements.primegodling.primordial_sup: Evolve to Primordial Supreme God — the apex of the Godling line

advancements.primegodling.divine_nexus.r: You are now connected to the primordial source. Creation Authority granted.
